mapper.sql: COALESCE(ends_at, (date_trunc('day', starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'Pacific/Auckland') + interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'Pacific/Auckland')
mapper.select: SELECT slug, title, starts_at, ends_at, venue_name, image_url, ST_Y(location::geometry) AS latitude, ST_X(location::geometry) AS longitude, description, address, source, source_url, updated_at, < #{now} AS ended FROM event WHERE slug = #{slug} AND status = 'public'

SELECT slug, title, starts_at, ends_at, venue_name, image_url, ST_Y(location::geometry) AS latitude, ST_X(location::geometry) AS longitude
ORDER BY starts_at, id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
